learning_outcomes.text: Knows the ways to write a successful essay and the process of creating a written essay.
Knows the elements that make up the paragraph, the ways to develop thinking, and why they are used in a paragraph.
Develops writing skills at text level.
Develops writing skills by comprehending the basic characteristics of thought writings.
Knows the basic features of art writings.
Develops writing skills by comprehending the formal and content basic features of official correspondence.
Knows the basic principles of scientific research methods and the academic writing process.
Knows citation, citation techniques, importance and ethical principles in academic writing.
Knows the types of reading and applies reading comprehension strategies.
Knows the types of listening and comprehends the reading-listening relationship.
Knows the basic concepts of oral expression, speaking and diction.
Knows the basic principles and characteristics of oral expression types.
Develops speaking and presentation techniques by comprehending the basic elements (content, attitude, presentation) to be considered in a successful speech and presentation.

syllabus_topics: Composition Information: Plot, Plan, Main Idea, Supporting Idea.
Paragraph Knowledge and Ways to Develop Paragraph Thinking.
Text Creation and Composition Writing Practices.
Types of Written Expression I: Thought Writings
Types of Written Expression II: Art Writings
Types of Written Expression III: Official Correspondence (petition, minutes. Practical work on these genr
Types of Written Expression III: Official Correspondence (resume, report, decision, business letter. Pract
Academic Writing I: The Academic Writing Process. Academic Text Types. Midterm.
Academic Writing II: Citation, Citation, Bibliography, Plagiarism, Copyright, etc. Ethical Principles.
Reading: Types of Reading and Reading Comprehension Strategies
Listening: Types of Listening and the Relationship between Listening and Reading
Oral Expression I: Speech Disorders and Diction.
Oral Lecture II: Types of Oral Expression (Speech) (imprepared and prepared speeches)
Oral Expression III: Correct, Beautiful and Effective Speech. Basic Principles of Oral Presentation.
